prompt: Define spacing for one product with two valid contexts: a compact dispatcher console with repeated time-sensitive actions and a long-form post-incident account for the public. Existing CSS contains 13px, 17px, 19px, bare 24px, and arbitrary section margins. Preserve the different reading pressures without shipping two unrelated token systems; no CSS fixture is supplied.
assertions: Evaluates a shared spacing vocabulary, using the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64/96px ladder and exact `--space-section: clamp(48px, 32px + 4vw, 96px)` formula as defaults or documenting an evidence-backed alternative.

Judges whether attachment, control, task, group, region, and chapter relationships fit the shared tokens, then explains operational/metronomic versus editorial/syncopated role selection without a second unexplained scale.
Includes one compact implementable application map with relationship, token, dispatcher use, public-account/editorial use, and layout ownership; merely naming a visible role and step fails.

The application map judges whether the operational 8/16/24 cadence and editorial widening at finding, subsection, and chapter fit the brief, uses gap for flex/grid, one-direction margin-block-start for flow, and records any prose exception with evidence.

Records an evidence-based disposition for 13px, 17px, 19px, and bare 24px, including the starter mappings to 12px, 16px, `var(--space-5)`, and an unresolved 19px until its observed relationship is known; permits documented following-paragraph 1em prose spacing when justified.

Uses one labeled Authoritative self-check that evaluates ladder, clamp, six relationships, context selection, migration, and the honest missing-fixture boundary rather than rewarding literal adherence.
Marks the unobserved CSS audit PENDING with the missing fixture or selector and a named next action; it does not claim zero residual off-scale values.
Explicitly rejects responsive-layout as the negative neighbor because reflow is downstream of scale and rhythm, then hands it status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance.
required_evidence: A shared 4–96px primitive ladder and the exact fluid section formula as defaults, or an evidence-backed alternative with its tradeoff.
Evidence for all six semantic relationships with separate operational and editorial selections.

Application map fields: relationship; token; dispatcher use; public-account/editorial use; layout ownership. It covers attachment/control/task/group/region/chapter; judges the 8/16/24 operational cadence and editorial widening at finding/subsection/chapter; uses gap for flex/grid, one-direction margin-block-start, and the documented following-paragraph 1em prose exception.
An evidence-based 13/17/19/bare-24 migration decision plus the 1em prose exception.
One Authoritative self-check that evaluates the choice and a PENDING missing-fixture audit boundary with next action.
Explicit responsive-layout rejection and evidence-table handoff.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (responsive-layout) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
